name: Angelo Prime

profile.archetype: The first sentinel, keeping the road open between every element and every side
profile.inspiredBy: the guardian angels of the first gate
profile.wings: a pair of broad pearl-white feathered wings with dove-grey primaries, each feather edged in warm champagne gold

palette.eyeColor: the reference image's own eye colour, unchanged and not recoloured, in clear irises with crisp definition
palette.eyeColorGlamour: the reference image's own eye colour, unchanged and not recoloured, in clear irises with crisp definition
palette.hairColor: the exact hair colour of the reference image, unchanged and not recoloured, with natural shine
palette.skinTone: natural skin tone from the reference image, evenly toned and lightly enhanced - do not alter undertone

physique.chest: Defined, naturally muscular chest and core, toned and healthy, not exaggerated

notes: Calibration test-bed hero — NOT part of any real card series (group: angel-primes). Eyes/hair/skin are deliberately adaptive wording (enhance the reference photo's own likeness rather than impose a fixed look), with empty eye/skin negative lists, so this hero validates pose/hair/motion prompt changes against any arbitrary input photo. Physique stays a fixed description, same convention as the Drakn sisters. Palette (Soft Pearl White / Warm Champagne Gold / Dove Grey) is a fixed, generic 'angel' wardrobe scheme governing only the test outfit, not the subject's natural colouring. First male hero in the art pipeline — introduced pose-male-human.txt and the male physique (build/chest/waist/legs) branch in gen_prompt.py's tokens_for(). Hair and eye colour are generic on purpose: both Primes are the test for any original photo, so the wording keeps the reference image's own hair and eye colour unchanged (no enhancement, no recolouring, no eye glow in their scenes). The other angels may use more specific looks.
